q: Who is called the father of civil services in India?
x: Lord Cornwallis (Governor-General 1786–93) organised and reformed the civil services.

q: Who called the All India Services the "steel frame" of India?
x: Sardar Patel defended the All India Services in the Constituent Assembly and called them the steel frame.

q: Who was the first Indian to join the Indian Civil Service?
x: Satyendranath Tagore, elder brother of Rabindranath, qualified in 1863.

q: Which committee designed the prelims–mains–interview pattern of the civil services exam?
x: The D.S. Kothari Committee (1976) recommended the three-stage exam, used from 1979.

q: In which year was the first Public Service Commission set up in India?
x: The Public Service Commission was set up in 1926 on the advice of the Lee Commission (1924).

q: Under the RTI Act, a reply normally must be given within how many days?
x: 30 days. If the life or liberty of a person is involved, it must be given within 48 hours.

q: The Citizens' Charter idea began in which country?
x: It began in Britain in 1991 under PM John Major.

q: Which of these is NOT one of the three parts of the Sevottam model?
x: Sevottam has three parts: Citizens' Charter, grievance (complaint) handling and service delivery capability.
Dr L.M. Singhvi coined "Lokpal" and "Lokayukta" in 1963.

q: Who chaired the 2nd Administrative Reforms Commission?
x: The 2nd ARC (2005) was chaired by M. Veerappa Moily. The 1st ARC (1966) was chaired first by Morarji Desai, then K. Hanumanthaiya.

q: In the JAM trinity, what does "M" stand for?
x: JAM = Jan Dhan (bank account), Aadhaar (identity) and Mobile, used for direct benefit transfer.
Digital India was launched on 1 July 2015.

q: When is Civil Services Day observed?
x: 21 April, the day in 1947 when Sardar Patel addressed the first batch of officers.

q: Which commission said Governors should be non-partisan persons from outside the state?
x: The Sarkaria Commission (1983–88) on Centre–State relations.

q: Which Article lets Parliament create a new All India Service?
x: Article 312, after the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution with a two-thirds majority.
